excerpt: Contribute to yaminbakoh4-dot/NexusMem development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Your coding agent can read git log. It cannot read the four things you tried last Tuesday that didn't work.

NexusMem records what actually happened on your machine (shell commands and their exit codes, git history, project docs, optionally your assistant transcripts) into a local SQLite database, and serves back a ranked, token-budgeted slice of it on demand. Everything stays on disk. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

The shell history is the part worth caring about. Git tells an agent what shipped. Shell history tells it what was attempted, in what order, and which commands exited non-zero. That information exists nowhere else, and it disappears when your terminal scrollback rolls over.

Try it

From inside any git repository:

npx nexusmem init
npx nexusmem sync

Then ask it something. Real output from this repository, top 2 of 5 hits:

$ nexusmem query "windows spawn failure"

Relevant history for: windows spawn failure

- 2026-08-09 fix: distinguish a failed git spawn from "not a git repository"
  readRepoInfo collapsed three unrelated failures into one error: git running and reporting
  the path is not a work tree, git not being installed, and the process failing to spawn at
  all. Dogfooding hit the third case in two separate sessions...
- 2026-08-09 README.md — Before a tagged release
  - [ ] Retry on transient process-spawn failures on Windows

A commit and a docs section, ranked against each other, inside whatever token budget you gave it. Nothing was summarized by a model on the way out; the ranker just decided what not to send.

For a sense of what actually accumulates, here is nexusmem status on this repo after two days:

527 node(s)  2026-08-08 .. 2026-08-09
       321  shell_command
       130  conversation_turn
        60  doc_section
        16  git_commit

Sixteen commits. Three hundred and twenty-one shell commands. The commits were already retrievable by any agent with a terminal. The rest was not.

That conversation_turn row only appears because this corpus was synced with --conversation. Assistant transcripts are the one source that is off by default and stays off until you opt in, since they are the likeliest place for a pasted credential to be sitting. A default install indexes git, shell and docs.

Requirements: Node 22 or newer, and git. Node 20 will not work, because better-sqlite3 ships no prebuilt binary for it and Node 20 went end-of-life in April 2026. Ollama is optional and only affects semantic search (see below).

How retrieval works

Every source normalizes to the same MemoryNode shape, so a commit, a shell command and a docs section compete on equal terms. Retrieval runs BM25 over FTS5 and, if an embedding model is reachable, a vector search over sqlite-vec, then fuses the two with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

RRF fuses on rank position only, never on raw scores. That is the entire reason it is safe here: a BM25 cost and a vector distance live on unrelated, unbounded scales, and position is the only thing they agree on. No hand-tuned normalization constant sits between them.

Ranking then multiplies three factors:

score = relevance × signal^0.431 × recency^0.576

relevance comes from the query. signal (a fix: commit outranks a chore:; a command that exited non-zero outranks one that succeeded) and recency are priors that hold before any query exists. Each factor is floored into [floor, 1] rather than [0, 1], so one weak dimension cannot zero out a strong match.

Those exponents are derived, not tuned. Priors kept overturning the query: on one real query a fix: commit took rank 1 from a better-matching docs section on a 44% signal edge against a 15% relevance deficit. So each prior is raised to the power that caps its entire range at overturning a 2× relevance gap, by solving span^exponent = 2. Priors still order equally-relevant hits exactly as before, since the transform is monotonic. They just cannot outvote the question anymore.

Without Ollama, vector search is skipped and you get BM25 only. That path is fully supported, not a degraded error state; sync and query both succeed and simply do less.

Use it from an agent

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexusmem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "nexusmem", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}

Three tools over stdio: search_memory returns the packed context block, sync_project ingests, and get_status reports what is currently remembered. Each takes an explicit projectRoot, because an MCP tool call carries no shell working directory. sync_project runs init for you if the repository has not been set up.

Optional: exact shell capture

Scraped history files (PSReadLine, .bash_history, .zsh_history) give you command text and not much else. The hook gives you working directory, exit code and a real timestamp:

nexusmem hook install

It wraps your existing PowerShell prompt rather than replacing it, is idempotent, and nexusmem hook remove undoes it cleanly.

Exit codes are what make this worth installing. A failed command is a stronger signal than a successful one, and without the hook there is no way to tell them apart.

What it costs you

Two numbers get conflated in tools like this, so they are kept apart here.

Packer efficiency is how much the ranker trims from its own candidate set. On this repository's corpus it runs 81–84%. It is useful for tuning the ranker and useless as a claim about your bill, because the baseline is hypothetical: without NexusMem those candidates were never going into your context window in the first place.

End-to-end saving compares packed context against reading the equivalent files in full. Measured at ~40% on design queries against this codebase, hand-tallied from one real session rather than instrumented. Treat it as an order of magnitude.

The long-term target is >70%, and this repository cannot demonstrate it. That figure describes repos with thousands of commits, where the win comes from omitting hundreds of unrelated items rather than shaving a handful. A benchmark at that size is still outstanding, and until it exists the honest number is 40%.

One thing that is not a percentage: shell commands and conversation turns have no cheap grep equivalent. Without something recording them, they are gone, not merely more expensive to find.

Latency on a ~530-node corpus, warm, p50 over 10 runs:

Operation
BM25 retrieval (FTS5) ~1.1 ms
Vector KNN (sqlite-vec) ~3.2 ms
Fuse, rank, pack ~0.6 ms
Query embedding (local Ollama) ~55–77 ms
End-to-end hybrid ~56 ms

All the SQLite work totals about 5 ms. The embedding call is the only thing on this path worth optimizing, and it is somebody else's process.

Where it breaks

  • Shell history without the hook is unscoped. Scraped history has no directory context, so it is attributed to whichever repository you ran sync from. Bounded to a tail window, and an approximation rather than a guarantee.
  • Thai, Japanese and Chinese depend on the vector pass. FTS5's unicode61 tokenizer splits on whitespace, so languages without space boundaries get no useful BM25 recall.
  • Rebasing strands nodes. Rewritten history leaves nodes for unreachable commits. They describe real events so they are not wrong, but a targeted prune does not exist yet. sync --rebuild forces a clean re-scan.
  • Multi-line PowerShell input is read as separate commands. A function typed across several lines at the prompt is not reconstructed.
  • Scrape-fallback ids drift if the history file is trimmed from the front between syncs. Installing the hook fixes this.
  • The embedding pass is capped per sync, so a large corpus needs a few runs to embed fully.
  • Conversation chunking is unevaluated. Splitting long replies at heading boundaries measurably helped, but it has never been tested systematically.
  • A burst of recent, high-signal commits crowds unrelated queries. Each prior is individually capped at overturning a 2× relevance gap, but the caps are per-prior, not joint, so a node that is both very fresh and highly scored can overturn roughly 4×. Found by dogfooding: a query about the PowerShell hook returned two same-day fix: commits with nothing to do with it at ranks 3 and 4, while the section that actually answered the question sat at rank 6. Gets worse on days with a lot of commits, which are exactly the days you have most to remember.

Commands

init, sync, query <text>, status, mcp, and hook install|remove|status.

There are also four dry-run previews (scan-git, scan-shell, scan-docs, scan-conversation) that write nothing and print the nodes ingestion would create along with their signal scores. That is the intended way to tune scoring against a real repository before committing to a change. Add --json to pipe them somewhere.

Every command takes -C <path> to target another repository. On sync, --conversation opts the transcript source in for one run without persisting it, --no-embed skips the vector pass, and --rebuild drops the project's nodes and re-ingests from scratch.

On disk

<repo>/.nexusmem/
  .gitignore     '*' — the workspace ignores itself, so init never edits a file it doesn't own
  config.json    validated on read; a corrupt config fails loudly rather than silently
  memory.db      SQLite in WAL mode

Node ids are content-addressed from sha256(projectId + kind + naturalKey), so running sync twice cannot produce duplicates and ingestion stays correct even if a cursor is lost. Project identity comes from the normalized origin URL when there is one, falling back to the absolute path, so two clones of the same repo share one memory namespace.

Deleting .nexusmem/ loses nothing that sync cannot rebuild.

Status

Ingestion, hybrid retrieval, budgeted packing and the MCP server all work and are covered by 210 tests running on Linux and Windows across Node 22 and 24.

Not done yet: diff bodies are not indexed (commits stop at metadata and diff stats), queries are scoped to a single project, there is no local-model summarization pass, and the conversation collector has never been audited for the stale-node bug that was found and fixed in the docs collector.

Development

npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Tests are behavioral rather than snapshot-based, and several are regressions tied to specific observed failures. tests/git-errors.test.ts injects a fake spawn to exercise the Windows process-spawn faults, which cannot be provoked on demand.

On how this was built

This started as an experiment in whether a local context-memory engine for coding agents was viable, prototyped with Claude Code. The code was written through AI-assisted workflows; the architecture, the design decisions and the specifications were human-directed.

That is worth stating plainly because it should change how you read the code, not whether you trust it. Audits, corrections and PRs are genuinely welcome, and the commit history is deliberately detailed about why things are the way they are, including the times an earlier assumption turned out to be wrong.

License

sentences.en: Each factor is floored into [floor, 1] rather than [0, 1], so one weak dimension cannot zero out a strong match.
sentences.zh: 每个因子都被归入 [floor, 1] 而不是 [0, 1]，因此一个弱维度无法将强匹配归零。

blocks.html_en: Those exponents are derived, not tuned. Priors kept overturning the query: on one real query a fix: commit took rank 1 from a better-matching docs section on a 44% signal edge against a 15% relevance deficit. So each prior is raised to the power that caps its entire range at overturning a 2× relevance gap, by solving span^exponent = 2. Priors still order equally-relevant hits exactly as before, since the transform is monotonic. They just cannot outvote the question anymore.

sentences.en: Those exponents are derived, not tuned.
sentences.zh: 这些指数是导出的，而不是调整的。

sentences.en: Priors kept overturning the query: on one real query a fix: commit took rank 1 from a better-matching docs section on a 44% signal edge against a 15% relevance deficit.
sentences.zh: 先验不断推翻查询：在一个真实查询中，修复：提交从更匹配的文档部分中获得排名 1，信号边缘为 44%，相关性不足为 15%。

sentences.en: So each prior is raised to the power that caps its entire range at overturning a 2× relevance gap, by solving span^exponent = 2.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过求解 span^exponent = 2，每个先验都被提升到了在推翻 2× 相关性间隙时限制其整个范围的幂。

sentences.en: Priors still order equally-relevant hits exactly as before, since the transform is monotonic.
sentences.zh: 先验者仍然像以前一样对同样相关的命中进行排序，因为变换是单调的。

sentences.en: They just cannot outvote the question anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不能再投票推翻这个问题了。

blocks.html_en: Without Ollama, vector search is skipped and you get BM25 only. That path is fully supported, not a degraded error state; sync and query both succeed and simply do less.

sentences.en: That path is fully supported, not a degraded error state; sync and query both succeed and simply do less.
sentences.zh: 该路径得到完全支持，而不是降级错误状态；同步和查询都成功，但做得更少。

blocks.html_en: Packer efficiency is how much the ranker trims from its own candidate set. On this repository's corpus it runs 81–84%. It is useful for tuning the ranker and useless as a claim about your bill, because the baseline is hypothetical: without NexusMem those candidates were never going into your context window in the first place.

sentences.en: Packer efficiency is how much the ranker trims from its own candidate set.
sentences.zh: 打包器效率是排序器从其自己的候选集中修剪的量。

sentences.en: On this repository's corpus it runs 81–84%.
sentences.zh: 在此存储库的语料库中，它的运行率为 81-84%。

sentences.en: It is useful for tuning the ranker and useless as a claim about your bill, because the baseline is hypothetical: without NexusMem those candidates were never going into your context window in the first place.
sentences.zh: 它对于调整排名很有用，但作为有关您的账单的声明毫无用处，因为基线是假设的：如果没有 NexusMem，这些候选人一开始就不会进入您的上下文窗口。

blocks.html_en: End-to-end saving compares packed context against reading the equivalent files in full. Measured at ~40% on design queries against this codebase, hand-tallied from one real session rather than instrumented. Treat it as an order of magnitude.

sentences.en: End-to-end saving compares packed context against reading the equivalent files in full.
sentences.zh: 端到端保存将打包上下文与完整读取等效文件进行比较。

sentences.en: Measured at ~40% on design queries against this codebase, hand-tallied from one real session rather than instrumented.
sentences.zh: 针对此代码库的设计查询的测量结果约为 40%，是从一个真实会话中手工统计的，而不是通过检测得出的。

sentences.en: Treat it as an order of magnitude.
sentences.zh: 将其视为一个数量级。

blocks.html_en: The long-term target is >70%, and this repository cannot demonstrate it. That figure describes repos with thousands of commits, where the win comes from omitting hundreds of unrelated items rather than shaving a handful. A benchmark at that size is still outstanding, and until it exists the honest number is 40%.

sentences.en: The long-term target is >70%, and this repository cannot demonstrate it.
sentences.zh: 长期目标是>70%，这个存储库无法演示它。

sentences.en: That figure describes repos with thousands of commits, where the win comes from omitting hundreds of unrelated items rather than shaving a handful.
sentences.zh: 该数字描述了具有数千次提交的存储库，其中的胜利来自于省略数百个不相关的项目，而不是删除少数项目。

sentences.en: A benchmark at that size is still outstanding, and until it exists the honest number is 40%.
sentences.zh: 这个规模的基准仍然很突出，在它存在之前，诚实的数字是 40%。

blocks.html_en: One thing that is not a percentage: shell commands and conversation turns have no cheap grep equivalent. Without something recording them, they are gone, not merely more expensive to find.

sentences.en: One thing that is not a percentage: shell commands and conversation turns have no cheap grep equivalent.
sentences.zh: 有一件事不是百分比：shell 命令和会话轮次没有廉价的 grep 等效项。

sentences.en: Without something recording them, they are gone, not merely more expensive to find.
sentences.zh: 如果没有任何东西记录它们，它们就会消失，而不仅仅是寻找起来更加昂贵。

blocks.html_en: Where it breaks

sentences.en: Where it breaks
sentences.zh: 哪里破裂了

blocks.html_en: • Shell history without the hook is unscoped. Scraped history has no directory context, so it is attributed to whichever repository you ran sync from. Bounded to a tail window, and an approximation rather than a guarantee.

sentences.en: Shell history without the hook is unscoped.
sentences.zh: 没有钩子的 shell 历史记录是无作用域的。

sentences.en: Scraped history has no directory context, so it is attributed to whichever repository you ran sync from.
sentences.zh: 抓取的历史记录没有目录上下文，因此它归因于您从中运行同步的任何存储库。

sentences.en: Bounded to a tail window, and an approximation rather than a guarantee.
sentences.zh: 受限于尾窗，并且是近似值而不是保证。

blocks.html_en: • Thai, Japanese and Chinese depend on the vector pass. FTS5's unicode61 tokenizer splits on whitespace, so languages without space boundaries get no useful BM25 recall.

sentences.en: Thai, Japanese and Chinese depend on the vector pass.
sentences.zh: 泰语、日语和中文取决于矢量通行证。

sentences.en: FTS5's unicode61 tokenizer splits on whitespace, so languages without space boundaries get no useful BM25 recall.
sentences.zh: FTS5 的 unicode61 分词器会根据空格进行分割，因此没有空格边界的语言无法进行有用的 BM25 召回。

blocks.html_en: • Rebasing strands nodes. Rewritten history leaves nodes for unreachable commits. They describe real events so they are not wrong, but a targeted prune does not exist yet. sync --rebuild forces a clean re-scan.

sentences.en: Rebasing strands nodes.
sentences.zh: 重新调整股线节点的基准。

sentences.en: Rewritten history leaves nodes for unreachable commits.
sentences.zh: 重写的历史记录留下了无法访问的提交的节点。

sentences.en: They describe real events so they are not wrong, but a targeted prune does not exist yet.
sentences.zh: 他们描述了真实的事件，因此他们没有错，但有针对性的修剪还不存在。

sentences.en: sync --rebuild forces a clean re-scan.
sentences.zh: sync --rebuild 强制进行干净的重新扫描。

blocks.html_en: • Multi-line PowerShell input is read as separate commands. A function typed across several lines at the prompt is not reconstructed.

sentences.en: Multi-line PowerShell input is read as separate commands.
sentences.zh: 多行 PowerShell 输入被读取为单独的命令。

sentences.en: A function typed across several lines at the prompt is not reconstructed.
sentences.zh: 在提示符下跨多行键入的函数不会被重建。

blocks.html_en: • Scrape-fallback ids drift if the history file is trimmed from the front between syncs. Installing the hook fixes this.

sentences.en: Scrape-fallback ids drift if the history file is trimmed from the front between syncs.
sentences.zh: 如果在同步之间从前面修剪历史文件，则抓取后备 ID 会发生漂移。

sentences.en: Installing the hook fixes this.
sentences.zh: 安装钩子可以解决这个问题。

blocks.html_en: • The embedding pass is capped per sync, so a large corpus needs a few runs to embed fully.

sentences.en: The embedding pass is capped per sync, so a large corpus needs a few runs to embed fully.
sentences.zh: 每次同步的嵌入过程都有上限，因此大型语料库需要运行几次才能完全嵌入。

blocks.html_en: • Conversation chunking is unevaluated. Splitting long replies at heading boundaries measurably helped, but it has never been tested systematically.

sentences.en: Conversation chunking is unevaluated.
sentences.zh: 对话分块未被评估。

sentences.en: Splitting long replies at heading boundaries measurably helped, but it has never been tested systematically.
sentences.zh: 在标题边界处拆分长回复确实有帮助，但从未经过系统测试。

blocks.html_en: • A burst of recent, high-signal commits crowds unrelated queries. Each prior is individually capped at overturning a 2× relevance gap, but the caps are per-prior, not joint, so a node that is both very fresh and highly scored can overturn roughly 4×. Found by dogfooding: a query about the PowerShell hook returned two same-day fix: commits with nothing to do with it at ranks 3 and 4, while the section that actually answered the question sat at rank 6. Gets worse on days with a lot of commits, which are exactly the days you have most to remember.

sentences.en: A burst of recent, high-signal commits crowds unrelated queries.
sentences.zh: 最近爆​​发的一系列高信号引发了人群不相关的询问。

sentences.en: Each prior is individually capped at overturning a 2× relevance gap, but the caps are per-prior, not joint, so a node that is both very fresh and highly scored can overturn roughly 4×.
sentences.zh: 每个先验都被单独限制为推翻 2× 相关性差距，但上限是每个先验的，而不是联合的，因此非常新鲜且得分很高的节点可以推翻大约 4×。

sentences.en: Found by dogfooding: a query about the PowerShell hook returned two same-day fix: commits with nothing to do with it at ranks 3 and 4, while the section that actually answered the question sat at rank 6.
sentences.zh: 通过dogfooding发现：有关PowerShell钩子的查询返回了两个当天的修复：与它无关的提交位于第3和第4位，而实际回答问题的部分位于第6位。

sentences.en: Gets worse on days with a lot of commits, which are exactly the days you have most to remember.
sentences.zh: 在有大量提交的日子里，情况会变得更糟，而这正是您最值得记住的日子。

blocks.html_en: MIT

content_html_zh:
您的编码代理可以读取 git log。 它无法读取您上周二尝试过但不起作用的四件事。

NexusMem 将您的机器上实际发生的情况（shell 命令及其退出代码、git 历史记录、项目文档、可选的助理成绩单）记录到本地 SQLite 数据库中，并根据需要提供排名的、令牌预算的切片。 一切都保留在磁盘上。 没有帐户，没有云，没有遥测。

shell的历史是值得关心的部分。 Git 告诉代理发送了什么。 Shell 历史记录告诉它尝试了什么、按什么顺序以及哪些命令以非零值退出。 该信息不存在于其他地方，并且当您的终端回滚时它就会消失。

Try it

从任何 git 存储库内部：

npx nexusmem init
npx nexusmem sync

然后问它一些事情。 此存储库的实际输出，前 5 个命中中的前 2 个：

$ nexusmem query "windows spawn failure"

Relevant history for: windows spawn failure

- 2026-08-09 fix: distinguish a failed git spawn from "not a git repository"
  readRepoInfo collapsed three unrelated failures into one error: git running and reporting
  the path is not a work tree, git not being installed, and the process failing to spawn at
  all. Dogfooding hit the third case in two separate sessions...
- 2026-08-09 README.md — Before a tagged release
  - [ ] Retry on transient process-spawn failures on Windows

提交和文档部分，在您提供的任何代币预算内相互排名。 模型在退出时没有总结任何内容；排名者刚刚决定不发送什么。

为了了解实际积累的情况，以下是两天后此存储库上的 nexusmem 状态：

527 node(s)  2026-08-08 .. 2026-08-09
       321  shell_command
       130  conversation_turn
        60  doc_section
        16  git_commit

十六次提交。 三百二十一个 shell 命令。 任何具有终端的代理都可以检索这些提交。 其余的则不然。

该 conversation_turn 行仅出现，因为该语料库已与 --conversation 同步。 助理成绩单是默认关闭的一个来源，并且在您选择加入之前一直保持关闭状态，因为它们是最有可能放置粘贴凭证的地方。 默认安装索引 git、shell 和 docs。

要求：Node 22 或更高版本，以及 git。 Node 20 将无法工作，因为 better-sqlite3 没有为其提供预构建的二进制文件，并且 Node 20 已于 2026 年 4 月终止生命周期。 Ollama 是可选的，仅影响语义搜索（见下文）。

检索的工作原理

每个源都标准化为相同的 MemoryNode 形状，因此提交、shell 命令和文档部分平等竞争。 检索在 FTS5 上运行 BM25，如果嵌入模型可达，则在 sqlite-vec 上进行向量搜索，然后使用倒数排名融合将两者融合。

RRF 仅融合排名位置，从不融合原始分数。 这就是它在这里安全的全部原因：BM25 成本和向量距离存在于不相关的、无界的尺度上，并且位置是它们唯一达成一致的事情。 它们之间没有手动调整的归一化常数。

排名乘以三个因素：

score = relevance × signal^0.431 × recency^0.576

相关性来自查询。 信号（修复：提交胜过杂务：；退出非零的命令胜过成功的命令）和新近度是在任何查询存在之前保持的先验。 每个因子都被归入 [floor, 1] 而不是 [0, 1]，因此一个弱维度无法将强匹配归零。

这些指数是导出的，而不是调整的。 先验不断推翻查询：在一个真实查询中，修复：提交从更匹配的文档部分中获得排名 1，信号边缘为 44%，相关性不足为 15%。 因此，通过求解 span^exponent = 2，每个先验都被提升到了在推翻 2× 相关性间隙时限制其整个范围的幂。 先验者仍然像以前一样对同样相关的命中进行排序，因为变换是单调的。 他们只是不能再投票推翻这个问题了。

如果没有 Ollama，将跳过矢量搜索，您只能得到 BM25。 该路径得到完全支持，而不是降级错误状态；同步和查询都成功，但做得更少。

从代理处使用

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexusmem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "nexusmem", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}

stdio 上的三个工具：search_memory 返回打包的上下​​文块，sync_project 摄取，get_status 报告当前记住的内容。 每个都采用显式的projectRoot，因为MCP工具调用不携带shell工作目录。 如果尚未设置存储库，sync_project 会为您运行 init。

可选：精确捕获外壳

抓取的历史文件（PSReadLine、.bash_history、.zsh_history）为您提供命令文本，仅此而已。 该钩子为您提供工作目录、退出代码和真实时间戳：

nexusmem hook install

它包装您现有的 PowerShell 提示符而不是替换它，是幂等的，并且 nexusmem hook remove 可以干净地撤消它。

退出代码使得这个值得安装。 失败的命令比成功的命令发出的信号更强，如果没有钩子，就无法区分它们。

你要付出什么代价

两个数字在这样的工具中会被混淆，因此它们在这里被分开。

打包器效率是排序器从其自己的候选集中修剪的量。 在此存储库的语料库中，它的运行率为 81-84%。 它对于调整排名很有用，但作为有关您的账单的声明毫无用处，因为基线是假设的：如果没有 NexusMem，这些候选人一开始就不会进入您的上下文窗口。

端到端保存将打包上下文与完整读取等效文件进行比较。 针对此代码库的设计查询的测量结果约为 40%，是从一个真实会话中手工统计的，而不是通过检测得出的。 将其视为一个数量级。

长期目标是>70%，这个存储库无法演示它。 该数字描述了具有数千次提交的存储库，其中的胜利来自于省略数百个不相关的项目，而不是删除少数项目。 这个规模的基准仍然很突出，在它存在之前，诚实的数字是 40%。

有一件事不是百分比：shell 命令和会话轮次没有廉价的 grep 等效项。 如果没有任何东西记录它们，它们就会消失，而不仅仅是寻找起来更加昂贵。

大约 530 个节点的语料库上的延迟，热，p50 超过 10 次运行：

手术
BM25 检索 (FTS5) ~1.1 ms
向量 KNN (sqlite-vec) ~3.2 ms
保险丝、等级、包装 ~0.6 ms
查询嵌入（本地 Ollama） ~55–77 ms
端到端混合 ~56 ms

所有 SQLite 工作总共大约 5 毫秒。 嵌入调用是这条路径上唯一值得优化的东西，而且它是其他人的过程。

哪里破裂了

  • 没有钩子的 shell 历史记录是无作用域的。 抓取的历史记录没有目录上下文，因此它归因于您从中运行同步的任何存储库。 受限于尾窗，并且是近似值而不是保证。
  • 泰语、日语和中文取决于矢量通行证。 FTS5 的 unicode61 分词器会根据空格进行分割，因此没有空格边界的语言无法进行有用的 BM25 召回。
  • 重新调整股线节点的基准。 重写的历史记录留下了无法访问的提交的节点。 他们描述了真实的事件，因此他们没有错，但有针对性的修剪还不存在。 sync --rebuild 强制进行干净的重新扫描。
  • 多行 PowerShell 输入被读取为单独的命令。 在提示符下跨多行键入的函数不会被重建。
  • 如果在同步之间从前面修剪历史文件，则抓取后备 ID 会发生漂移。 安装钩子可以解决这个问题。
  • 每次同步的嵌入过程都有上限，因此大型语料库需要运行几次才能完全嵌入。
  • 对话分块未被评估。 在标题边界处拆分长回复确实有帮助，但从未经过系统测试。
  • 最近爆​​发的一系列高信号引发了人群不相关的询问。 每个先验都被单独限制为推翻 2× 相关性差距，但上限是每个先验的，而不是联合的，因此非常新鲜且得分很高的节点可以推翻大约 4×。 通过dogfooding发现：有关PowerShell钩子的查询返回了两个当天的修复：与它无关的提交位于第3和第4位，而实际回答问题的部分位于第6位。 在有大量提交的日子里，情况会变得更糟，而这正是您最值得记住的日子。

命令

初始化、同步、查询<文本>、状态、mcp 和挂钩安装|删除|状态。

还有四个空运行预览（scan-git、scan-shell、scan-docs、scan-conversation），它们不写入任何内容并打印摄取将创建的节点及其信号分数。 这是在提交更改之前根据真实存储库调整评分的预期方法。 添加 --json 将它们通过管道传输到某个地方。

每个命令都使用 -C <path> 来定位另一个存储库。 同步时，--conversation 选择一次运行的转录源而不保留它，--no-embed 跳过向量传递，--rebuild 删除项目的节点并从头开始重新摄取。

在磁盘上

<repo>/.nexusmem/
  .gitignore     '*' — the workspace ignores itself, so init never edits a file it doesn't own
  config.json    validated on read; a corrupt config fails loudly rather than silently
  memory.db      SQLite in WAL mode

节点 ID 是根据 sha256(projectId + kind + naturalKey) 进行内容寻址的，因此运行两次同步不会产生重复，并且即使光标丢失，摄取也能保持正确。 项目标识来自规范化的原始 URL（当有一个项目时），回落到绝对路径，因此同一存储库的两个克隆共享一个内存命名空间。

删除 .nexusmem/ 不会丢失同步无法重建的任何内容。

地位

摄取、混合检索、预算打包和 MCP 服务器均正常工作，并涵盖在 Linux 和 Windows 上跨节点 22 和 24 运行的 210 项测试。

尚未完成：diff 主体未建立索引（提交在元数据和 diff 统计信息处停止），查询范围仅限于单个项目，没有本地模型摘要传递，并且对话收集器从未针对在文档收集器中发现并修复的陈旧节点错误进行审核。

发展

npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

测试是行为性的而不是基于快照的，并且一些测试是与特定观察到的故障相关的回归。 test/git-errors.test.ts 注入一个假的生成来执行 Windows 进程生成错误，该错误不能按需引发。

关于这是如何构建的

这是一个实验，旨在研究用于编码代理的本地上下文记忆引擎是否可行，并以 Claude Code 为原型。 代码是通过人工智能辅助工作流程编写的；架构、设计决策和规范都是以人为主导的。

这值得明确说明，因为它应该改变您阅读代码的方式，而不是您是否信任它。 审计、更正和 PR 是真正受欢迎的，并且提交历史记录是故意详细说明为什么事情是这样的，包括早期假设被证明是错误的时间。
